arrivalDepartureConventions.note: Standard managed travellers arrive 29 Sep; programme-critical travellers (importance REQUIRED on any on-stage role) must be landside at least 12 hours before their first commitment (policy clause arrivalBuffer + rule-ait-arrival-min-buffer). Land by 23:00 the evening before the first commitment when the buffer allows it.

checkInAndBadge.note: On-stage cast must be badge-in and stage-ready at least 60 minutes before their session; sound check runs 07:30-08:30 each event morning (policy clause rehearsalAndRestRules).

groundTransfers.note: Estimated door-to-door durations used for transfer scheduling. Shapes mirror DurationEstimateSchema (src/domain/common.ts) so deterministic buffer checks can consume them directly.

dutyOfCare.escalation: Disruptions affecting programme-critical travellers escalate to the organiser duty manager within 30 minutes of observation.
